born.why: The code improves safety by using trait-based generalization to avoid poisonous fruits even with limited species history, adds recency weighting to reject recently harmful items, and balances foraging efficiency by carrying safe fruits when hunger is moderate.

The code prioritizes survival by eating only when critical starvation threatens, uses taste to safely identify new fruits via small bites, carries known good fruits for storage when not starving, and avoids known poisonous ones, balancing immediate hunger relief with long-term pantry security.

The code prioritizes survival by eating immediately when starving, avoids confirmed poisonous fruits by checking the diary, and uses a "taste first" strategy for unknown or moderately stocked new fruits to learn their safety profile before committing to carrying or eating them all.

The code prioritizes survival by avoiding known poisonous fruits (leaving them), uses tasting to gather data on new fruits, and distinguishes between carrying for the pantry (when not immediately starving) and direct eating (when hungry or urgent), ensuring Fagi learns from experience while minimizing unnecessary risk.

The code improves survival by generalizing poison avoidance across similar-looking fruits using trait matching, while distinguishing between immediate hunger relief (eating) and long-term security (carrying) based on current hunger levels.
